title: Restore writes packages into a shared machine location
description: nuget.config declares a `globalPackagesFolder` outside the workspace. A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `globalPackagesFolder` outside the workspace.
remediation: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a `globalPackagesFolder` outside the workspace.
limitation: It matches a `globalPackagesFolder` outside the workspace in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
